mapper.select:
select log_id, baby_id, module_code, action_code, summary, operator_id, operator_name, create_time from nc_oper_log
baby_id = #{babyId} and module_code = #{moduleCode}
and create_time >= to_timestamp(#{params.beginTime},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and create_time <= to_timestamp(#{params.endTime},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss')
order by create_time desc, log_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into nc_oper_log (baby_id, module_code, action_code, summary, operator_id, operator_name, create_time) values (#{babyId}, #{moduleCode}, #{actionCode}, #{summary}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, current_timestamp)
